newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Pudong New Area GDP soars 17.7 pct in H1.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Pudong New Area GDP soars 17.7 pct in H1.

text.p: Shanghai's premier economic development zone of Pudong generated 25.7 billion yuan ($3.4 billion) in gross domestic product (GDP) in the first half of 1997, the Business News said on Friday.
The figure was up 17.7 percent from the same period in 1996 and was four percentage points higher than the city's total GDP growth, the newspaper said.

Total output value generated by the Pudong New Area, east of Shanghai's city centre and across the Huangpu River, was 63.388 billion yuan in the first half of 1997, up 17.2 percent compared with the same 1996 period, it said.
Fixed asset investment in Pudong was 14.734 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 42.8 percent and representing 29.5 percent of the 1997 target, it said.
